en: Black-and-white postcard showing a grand, early-20th‑century spa hotel complex and theatre. On the left is a multi‑storey building with dormer windows and an ornate entrance; on the right is a neoclassical theatre with a portico and columns, labeled "KURTHEATER" on the pediment. In front are landscaped gardens, steps, lawns, trees, and a curved driveway with several people strolling and an early automobile. Handwritten-style caption text appears at the bottom right.
